set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Rank-one through rank-four arrays expose only the matching fixed-arity apply methods.
- Mutable arrays expose only the matching fixed-arity update methods.
- Wrong arity and transpose on a statically non-rank-two array fail compileErrors tests.
- AnyRank and ranks above four retain explicit at and updateAt fallbacks.
- Dynamic rank has an explicit checked rank-two transpose path.
- Runtime bounds errors remain precise for valid arity.
- The design is prototyped against Scala 3 extension-overload behavior before public methods are removed.
set.title: Make fixed-rank indexing, update, and transpose compile-time safe
